site.name: CRESTVIEW ESTATES
site.meta_description: Crestview Estates — 30+ private residences in Los Angeles. Warm stone architecture, resort amenities, and timeless design. Book a private tour.

hero.caption: A modern residence inspired by warm stone, quiet luxury, and the lasting beauty of timeless design — reimagined for Los Angeles.

paragraphs: Crestview Estates is a modern residential address shaped by warm California light, refined architecture, and the quiet beauty of everyday living. More than a place to stay, it is designed to change how home feels from the moment you arrive.

Inspired by timeless materials, soft natural light, and the rhythm of private family life, Crestview brings together spacious residences, calm outdoor spaces, and thoughtful details that make daily living feel considered. Every line, texture, and view is designed with purpose, not for excess, but to make home feel lasting, personal, and deeply comfortable.

list.title: Pool
list.description: A sun-warmed lap pool and terrace, screened by planting from the street below.

list.title: Gym
list.description: A full fitness studio with strength and cardio equipment, open around the clock.

list.title: Spa
list.description: Steam, sauna, and treatment rooms for slow mornings and quiet recovery.

list.title: Dining
list.description: A private dining room and chef's kitchen for gathering residents and guests.

retreat.heading: A Slower Way to Live
retreat.paragraph: Designed as a quiet retreat within the city, Crestview brings together spaces for rest, movement, gathering, and reflection. Warm stone, soft lighting, water, greenery, and open-air moments create an atmosphere where everyday living feels slower, calmer, and more considered.

testimonial.quote: Crestview felt less like buying a residence and more like discovering how we actually wanted to live — the light, the quiet, the details we didn't know to ask for.

location.heading: Set in Los Angeles
location.paragraph: Crestview Estates sits on a quiet residential rise in Los Angeles, minutes from the coast and close to the city's best dining, culture, and canyon trails — private enough to feel like a retreat, close enough to stay connected.
